children: Teucrium Wheat Fund will be permitted to invest in KC Hard Red Winter and MGEX Hard Red Spring wheat futures as an alternative to its benchmark contracts.
The Sponsor allows the Fund to invest in KC HRW and MGEX HRS futures effective immediately to address position limits.
The Fund's objective, benchmark and benchmark component futures remain unchanged; alternatives used only if benchmark limits restrict needed exposure.
Allocation to alternative contracts and contract-month matching are at the Sponsor's sole discretion and may reduce benchmark correlation.
Prospectus supplement filed Aug 31, 2026; updated holdings for next NAV are posted at teucrium.com/weat.
